shadows.purpose: Project card hover only, paired with -4px translateY.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Contact modal and detail modals against the backdrop.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default ease-out-quart for entrances and state transitions; no bounce or elastic.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action button (e.g. hero CTA, contact submit).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #d97706; color: #fafaf9; padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; border: none; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #b45309; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d97706; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: Project grid card with hover lift.
components.html:
Project Name

Short description of the project.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e7e5e4; border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), border-color 0.2s; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(28,25,23,0.08); border-color: #fcd34d; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.125rem; color: #1c1917; } .ds-card-desc { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; color: #57534e; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar navigation link, default and active state.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 8px; color: #57534e; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #f5f5f4; color: #1c1917; } .ds-nav-item[aria-current='page'] { background: #fffbeb; color: #b45309; }

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: Topic/skill tag chip used on project cards.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; background: #f5f5f4; color: #57534e; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 9999px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field used in the contact modal.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid #e7e5e4; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; color: #1c1917; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #d97706; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(217,119,6,0.3); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #a8a29e; }

narrative.overview: A craftsperson's workspace, not a showroom: warm stone surfaces, one deliberate accent color, nothing decorative left lying around. The system reads as personal and hand-considered rather than templated. Personality shows up in small, specific details rather than gradients, saturated color fields, or motion for its own sake. The palette is intentionally narrow: stone neutrals do almost all the work, amber appears only where it earns attention. Typography carries the craft signal: a serif display face for headlines paired with a clean grotesque for everything functional.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained, stone-neutral surface with a single warm accent
Serif display + sans body, high contrast between the two
Flat-by-default surfaces; elevation is a response to interaction, not decoration
Motion is functional and calm — no bounce, no unexplained flourish
Personality lives in copy, craft, and small interaction details, not ornament

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Amber is the only saturated color in the system. It appears on primary actions and nothing else competes with it.

rules.name: The Cream-Bg Check
rules.body: #fafaf9 stays because it's near-zero chroma, not because 'warm' was the reflex. If any future pass pushes it warmer/more saturated, that's a regression.

rules.name: The Serif-Only-For-Display Rule
rules.body: Fraunces appears only in headlines. Body copy, UI chrome, and labels are always Plus Jakarta Sans.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: No surface carries a shadow in its default state. Shadows are earned by interaction (hover, open/focus), never decorative.

dos: Do keep amber to primary actions and single accent moments.
Do use Fraunces exclusively for display/headline text.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest; earn shadows through interaction only.
Do pair every entrance or decorative animation with a prefers-reduced-motion fallback.
Do use ease-out-quart-style easing; keep distances small (10-20px).
donts: Don't ship the generic AI-portfolio template (cream/sand bg, gradient text, uppercase eyebrows, hero-metric blocks, identical icon-grid cards).
Don't use bounce or elastic easing.
Don't introduce a second saturated brand color.
Don't nest cards inside cards, or default to a card for every piece of content.
Don't use loud SaaS/startup marketing tone in copy.
